message: HOLD — 3 critical error(s) found. Correct before shipping.

critical_errors.description: Employee must sign and date Section 1 of Form I-9. Unsigned Section 1 = the form is incomplete and the verification is invalid.
critical_errors.check: Section 1 signed and dated by employee

critical_errors.description: Errors must be corrected by drawing a line through incorrect info, entering correct info, and initialing/dating the correction. White-out, correction fluid, or erasures are NOT allowed — increases liability under federal immigration law.
critical_errors.check: Corrections initialed and dated (no white-out or erasure)
critical_errors.notes: White-out used to correct DOB field

critical_errors.description: All signature lines must be signed by the correct signer. Signers cannot sign for each other.

passed.check: Correct document combination used (List A alone, OR List B + List C)
